name: SpongeBob
metaDescription: SpongeBob sound buttons — A Few Moments Later, boowomp, the fog horn and more Bikini Bottom classics. Play and download free.
intro:
No show has contributed more sounds to internet culture than SpongeBob SquarePants. The time cards, the fog horn, the boowomp, the sad song — an entire generation's comedic timing was calibrated in Bikini Bottom, and these are the clips that prove it.

This board collects the SpongeBob sounds people actually search for, as instant buttons with free MP3 downloads. Use them as transitions, fail stings, and nostalgia bombs — the French narrator alone can restructure any video you're editing.

faq.q: What is the most famous SpongeBob sound?
faq.a: The 'A Few Moments Later' time card is the most used — it's the default time-passing transition across YouTube and TikTok. The fog horn and boowomp are close behind.

faq.q: Can I use these in my videos?
faq.a: Short clips are widely used in edits and memes. For monetized or commercial work, clear rights first — these are excerpts from a copyrighted show.
